description: This Java class contains validation methods for different accounting rule types, providing utility methods to check specific accounting configurations such as cash-based, accrual periodic, and upfront accrual accounting.

classes.name: AccountingValidations
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to validate different accounting rule types based on provided rule type identifiers.

methods.name: isCashBasedAccounting
methods.description: Checks if the provided accounting rule type corresponds to cash-based accounting.

methods.name: isAccrualPeriodicBasedAccounting
methods.description: Checks if the provided accounting rule type corresponds to accrual periodic accounting.

methods.name: isUpfrontAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Checks if the provided accounting rule type corresponds to upfront accrual accounting.

methods.name: isAccrualBasedAccounting
methods.description: Checks if the provided accounting rule type is either accrual periodic or upfront.

methods.name: isCashOrAccrualBasedAccounting
methods.description: Checks if the accounting rule type is either cash-based or accrual-based.
